bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. Every bag is searched, and non-clear bags receive additional screening.
bagPolicy.note: The venue's FAQ also lists large bags over 10" x 10" as prohibited, so guests should use the more restrictive limit and travel light.

parking.note: Paid parking is available through Mandalay Bay Hotel & Casino; the venue does not validate parking.

rideshare.note: No dedicated rideshare zone is published in the current venue FAQ. Use the signed Mandalay Bay pickup and drop-off areas shown in your rideshare app.

concessions.note: The Music Hall sells local craft beer, light bites, and full-bar service during shows. The venue is cashless for concessions, bar, and in-venue ticket sales; a separate Restaurant & Bar is also on site.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Call the box office at 702-632-7600 for ADA or accessibility accommodations.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after entering the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The box office opens at noon on show days. Day-of-show will call requires a valid photo ID and the credit card used for purchase; call 702-632-7600 for advance pickup questions.

gates.title: Entrance & Doors
gates.body: The Music Hall entrance is inside Mandalay Bay. Check the event page for the latest door and entry requirements; eligible guests may use Pass the Line for early entry.
